pull.title: scrun: gate the strict planning sanity check behind a cluster setting
pull.body:
The schema changer plan sanity check walks every stage of the plan and is too expensive to run on every statement in production. This PR registers `sql.schemachanger.strict_planning_sanity_check.enabled`, which defaults to false, and only runs the check when it is enabled. Test builds turn it on.

The declarative schema changer design is described in docs/RFCS/20210115_new_schema_changer.md.

Epic: CRDB-12345
Release note: None

files.patch:
@@ -15,6 +15,13 @@ import (
 	"github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/sql/schemachanger/scplan"
 )
 
+var enforcePlannerSanityCheck = settings.RegisterBoolSetting(
+	settings.ApplicationLevel,
+	"sql.schemachanger.strict_planning_sanity_check.enabled",
+	"enforce strict sanity checks on the schema changer plan",
+	false,
+)
+
@@ -48,7 +55,7 @@ func makeState(ctx context.Context, sv *settings.Values, state scplan.State) (scplan.State, error) {
 	plan, err := scplan.MakePlan(ctx, state, scplan.Params{
-		EnforcePlannerSanityCheck: true,
+		EnforcePlannerSanityCheck: enforcePlannerSanityCheck.Get(sv),
 	})

commit.message:
scrun: gate the strict planning sanity check behind a cluster setting

Release note: None

reviews.body: Off by default in production is the right call; the check has caught real planner bugs in tests, so keep it on in test builds.
